BiblicalUsage: Daniel's God delivers: Nebuchadnezzar demands to know who can deliver from the furnace, and the three men answer that their God is able to deliver them. Darius labours until sunset to deliver Daniel from the lions, and Daniel tells him the next morning that God sent His angel and delivered him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe deliverance is God's own work, not mine, because every deliverance in Daniel comes when men have done all they can and it is still not enough. I hold that the God who shut the lions' mouths is the God I trust when there is nothing left for me to do.
RelatedEvents: Daniel in the Lions' Den; Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
